facts.fact: According to a Harris Poll survey, 63% of North American consumers expect brands to take a personalized marketing outreach approach.
facts.quote: According to a Harris Poll survey, [63%](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/marketers-struggle-to-deliver-omnichannel-personalization-that-consumers-crave) of North American consumers expect brands to take a personalized marketing outreach approach.

facts.fact: 43% of marketers admit they are struggling to meet consumer demand for personalized marketing.
facts.quote: However, as many performance media agencies shift gears to try and meet those demands, 43% of marketers admit they are struggling to do so.

facts.fact: The article suggests setting up retargeting, exclusion, or lookalike audiences from the start of an awareness campaign, since audiences not captured initially cannot be retargeted later.
facts.quote: This should be done right from the start, while your brand awareness campaign is in-market.

facts.fact: Connected TV ad units are not clickable, so conversions from CTV ads depend on a strong call to action that drives viewers to convert on another device.
facts.quote: Although CTV ad units are not clickable, having a strong call to action and reinforcing your brand can inspire your audience to complete a conversion on another device.

facts.fact: For conversion campaigns, advertisers should attach conversion events to track both view-through and click-through conversions to attribute results back to their campaign efforts.
facts.quote: Attach conversion events to track view-through and click-through conversions to attribute it back to your campaigns efforts.

facts.fact: Connected TV advertising lets advertisers granularly target households programmatically.
facts.quote: It enables advertisers to granularly target households programmatically.

facts.fact: Display banners come in static or highly customizable rich media forms and let advertisers track and monitor ad engagement.
facts.quote: They come in static or highly customizable rich media forms, enabling advertisers to track and monitor ad engagement.

facts.fact: For conversion campaigns on display, countdown units are suggested to drive users to act within a defined time period, such as before a sale or event ends.
facts.quote: the use of countdown units aimed at driving your users to perform an action in a defined time period
